latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Screen Recording Free — a cloud tool for editing and exporting screen capture videos.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) for fast, AI-powered editing and cleanup.
- Supports editing requests like trimming pauses, adding captions, and exporting as 1080p MP4.
- Sessions handle multiple video edits with tracking and preview features.
- All processing is done on cloud GPUs; no installation required.
- Includes support for user credits, session state, and error handling for uploads and exports.
- Designed for students, educators, and tutorial creators working with screen recordings.
